text:
The summary is accurate. The date, features, the 40% speed gain, ABN and email search, the CSV removal and its reason, the help article, the Android 9 end of updates and the coming-soon items all match the source. It also puts the one item needing action, the Classic CSV removal, in its own flagged paragraph, which suits a busy manager.

The main problem is length. I count about 124 words, which breaks the explicit "under 120 words" limit. The overrun is small but real. The response also spends words on lower-value items such as the per-client reminder wording and the bank feed, when trimming them would have kept it within the limit. It leaves out the GST rounding fix, which is minor.

Accuracy and content selection are strong, but missing a hard constraint costs points.

Score: 6
